text:
Irene C: Kicking off ad-hoc access sweep — found unexpected cross-account grant on key proj-payments-prod-key. Marking as urgent.
Sam W: And here I was about to schedule the regular quarterly recert. Good timing. What grant type?
Irene C: External principal AWS:arn:aws:iam::999888777:user/payment-exporter with kms:Decrypt. No owner listed in our key metadata.
Maya P: Oof. That matches a pattern from last year's export incident. We should quarantine that key from external principals immediately.
Zach R: Before lock-down, can we check recent usage? If it's in active use by a downstream partner we need a coordination window. @access-bot run key-usage proj-payments-prod-key 90d
access-bot: running key-usage for proj-payments-prod-key (90d). ETA ~2m
access-bot: key-usage complete. 21 Decrypt events in 90d from principal 999888777:user/payment-exporter — last seen 2026-03-14. Full log extract: https://go/redwood/logs/kms/proj-payments-prod-key/usage-4499998888
Nadia L: Paging infra/sales contact lists — who owns that external principal? I can reach out but need owner mapping.
Sam W: Our owner mapping is stale for some older keys. Action: add owner-discovery step to sweep. If owner not found, temporary deny for external principals.
Maya P: Agree. Also we need to include a composite-check for roles that could indirectly grant access (role assuming + kms perms). Add to detector.
Zach R: I'll add a check for assume-role chains >2 hops and perms that include kms:Decrypt. Those are risky.
Irene C: For the quarantine plan: 1) apply conditional deny for external principals 2) snapshot key policy and grants 3) alert owners + legal/compliance 4) 48h attestation window or escalate to security ops.
Sam W: Keep rollback safe: store snapshots in secure bucket with versioning and tie to ticket ACC-4499. If rollback needed, have an emergency playbook.
Maya P: Side note — attestation automation failed last quarter for ~6% of owners because DM webhook rate-limited. We need retry/backoff and a manager escalation path.
access-bot: attestation-runner status: previous run had 6% webhook failures (rate limit). Recommend backoff 2x and fallback to email + manager ping.
Nadia L: For outreach, can we include a short justification template: "Why does this principal need access?" + have owners attach CI job or ticket that proves business need. Makes audits easier.
Zach R: Good. Also adding requirement that any key with cross-account grants must have a documented justification and an automated log export to sec-logs for retention >=365d.
Irene C: Speaking of retention, some keys in eu-west have only 90d retention in sec-logs due to a misconfigured sink. We should block any admin changes until retention is corrected for those keys.
Sam W: Action item INF-7901 to fix sink config in eu regions. Tag eng-infra.
Maya P: Can we prioritize keys with external principals and high Decrypt frequency for remediation? Maybe top 10.
Zach R: Runbook: we classify by risk score = (cross-account? + recent decrypts*0.2 + no-owner? + composite-role-risk). I'll push a scoring script and CSV export.
access-bot: entitlement-scan complete. Totals: 62 candidate admin entitlements across IAM/KMS. 9 urgent (external principals w/ Decrypt), 18 elevated, 35 low. Export CSV: https://go/redwood/exports/entitlement-scan-4499998888.csv
Irene C: Opening VULN-2026-130 for the 9 urgent ones. P0 until mitigated. Adding remediation owners.
Nadia L: I'll start owner outreach for the payments key and attach INF-7901 + ACC-4499.
Maya P: Reminder: when we revoke a role, ensure we run a canary call pattern to detect production impact (3 sample calls per hour for 6 hours). If errors spike, auto-rollback.
Sam W: Noted. Canary pattern + 15m human rollback window. We'll also tag oncall in the change event.
Zach R: I'll publish the composite-role detector and scoring script in https://go/redwood/tools/access-scan and create a PR for the attestation retry logic.
Irene C: Weekly status check Friday 9am. Please add progress notes to ACC-4499.
Maya P: Thanks all. Keep communications short to avoid missing owner threads. :thumbsup:
